item.title: Grandmother will serve life in prison in connection with 2024 deaths of 2 Kansas moms
item.description: A woman accused of killing two Kansas mothers in 2024 was sentenced Monday afternoon in an Oklahoma courtroom, after she pleaded no contest and was found guilty in October 2025 of two counts of first-degree murder, two counts of unlawful removal of a dead body and two counts of unlawful desecration of a human corpse.
